app.name: Showtime
app.tagline: Run the disaster before the gates open.
app.disclaimer: Planning aid, not a safety certification.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Showtime
onboarding.lead: A crowd-safety planning studio. Load a venue, see it in 3D, and let AI red and blue teams stress-test your plan with real crowd simulations.
onboarding.hint_docker: Build the image with: make build-sim
onboarding.hint_search: Optional. Add TAVILY_API_KEY to .env for live sources; the incident dataset works without it.
onboarding.samples_lead: Each one opens with a finished red-team session you can replay instantly.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty_body: Start from a sample or create your own.
projects.confirm_delete_body: The project, its versions and its runs are removed. This cannot be undone.
projects.import_hint: Import a .showtime.zip, a venue .json or a .dxf drawing

workspace.no_run: No simulation yet. Run a stress test to see the crowd move.
workspace.invalid_venue: Fix the highlighted problems before running a simulation.
workspace.offline_banner: Some services are unavailable. Features that need them are paused.
workspace.search_off: Live search is off. Attack cards use the incident dataset.
workspace.llm_down: The local model isn't running. Text edits and the red team need it: make llm-up
workspace.sandbox_down: The simulation sandbox isn't ready. Instant estimates still work: make build-sim

tools.command_ph: Type a change, e.g. “move the stage 10 m back and add a 4 m door on the east wall”
tools.command_hint: Press / to type. Enter to apply.
tools.questions: A question before I change anything
tools.barrier_hint: Click points on the floor, double-click to finish.
tools.zone_hint: Click to place corners, double-click to close the zone.
tools.exit_hint: Click on an outer wall to place an exit.
tools.block_hint: Click an exit to block or reopen it. The instant estimate updates immediately.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.nothing: Select something in the 3D view to see and edit it.
inspector.rule_unconfirmed: Unconfirmed: tick after checking the source

metrics.no_hotspots: No area went above the warning level.

countdown.title: Latest safe time to start evacuating
countdown.start_within: Start evacuating within {d} of the alarm
countdown.too_late: Too late: evacuation would need to start {d} before the hazard
countdown.unknown: Run a stress test to compute the countdown
countdown.manual_body: Enter the expected gust speed to compute the countdown.

redteam.title: Red Team Night
redteam.lead: AI attackers build scenarios from real crowd incidents. Each one runs as a crowd simulation; AI defenders propose fixes, which are simulated again. Only measured improvements are kept.
redteam.empty: No red-team session yet. Start one to stress-test this plan.
redteam.finished_at_risk: Red team finished: the plan is still at risk
redteam.phase_screening: Ranking attacks with the instant estimate

report.title: Report
report.print_hint: PDF uses your browser's print dialog: choose “Save as PDF”.
report.empty: No report yet. Run a stress test or a red-team session first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.switch_hint: Switch to Nebius by editing .env: LLM_PROVIDER=nebius, SANDBOX_PROVIDER=nebius and your keys. See docs/NEBIUS_SWITCH.md.

errors.network: The Showtime server isn't reachable. Start it with: make up

home.title: Plan a safe event in minutes
home.lead: Show us where your event is. The AI tests what could go wrong and gives you a plan you can hand to your team.
home.way_map_lead: Search your place and click the building, park or field.
home.way_describe_lead: Write one sentence about the place. The AI draws it for you.
home.way_sample_lead: No venue yet? Start with a ready-made hall, field or street.
home.trust: Planning aid, not a safety certification. Every number comes from a simulation or a formula.
home.describe_lead: The AI drafts a venue from your words. You check and correct it next.
home.describe_ph: A 40 by 25 m hall with a stage on the north wall, two doors on the south side, 1,200 people
home.example_hall: A 40 by 25 m conference hall with a stage on the north wall, two 2 m doors on the south wall, 900 people
home.example_field: An open field 80 by 50 m with a stage in the north, two gates in the south and 5,000 people
home.example_alley: A narrow street 4 m wide and 50 m long with exits at both ends and 1,500 people
home.design_failed: The AI couldn't draft this venue.
home.try_template: Start from a template instead, then adjust it.
home.no_plans_body: Pick your place on the map above to start your first plan.
home.more_ways: Need a real place on the map or a file import?

place.title: Pick your place on the map
place.lead: Search for the place, click the building (indoor event) or the park, square or field (open-air event), then build it.
place.ready_lead: Next you check the doors and how many people are coming.

check.title: Check your venue
check.lead: Make sure the doors and the crowd look right, then test the plan.
check.scene_error: The saved scene has a problem. Open Expert view for details.
check.door_hint: Click next to an outer wall to place a 2 m door.
check.barrier_hint: Click to add points. Double-click to finish the barrier.
check.door_near_wall: Click closer to an outer wall to place a door.
check.no_exits: There are no exits. Add a door before testing.
check.nothing_selected: Select a door, barrier or area in 3D or in the list.
check.lock_hint: Locked items can't be moved or edited here. AI changes that touch them are flagged and can't be applied.
check.locked_note: Unlock it to change its size or position.
check.move_hint: Drag the arrows in 3D, or move it by a set distance.
check.proposed_exit_note: Simulations count this opening as open. Don't rely on it until it is built.
check.provenance_hint: This is your statement. Showtime records it but does not verify it.
check.source_ph: How and when it was measured
check.ask_label: Ask the AI to change the venue
check.ask_ph: Ask the AI to change the venue, e.g. "make the south doors 3 m wide"
check.ai_questions: The AI needs a detail first:
check.ai_failed: The AI couldn't turn that into a change. Try naming the door or area.
check.ai_unavailable: AI editing isn't available right now. You can still edit by hand.
check.conflict_hint: Unlock it first if this change is acceptable.
check.preview_shown: Shown in 3D with outlines ({n} items). Nothing is saved yet.
check.new_marked_proposed: New openings and barriers will be recorded as proposed. Mark them as already there if they exist.
check.preview_outdated: The venue changed since this suggestion. Ask again.
check.applied_hint: Results from earlier tests no longer match. Test the plan again.
check.locked_count: {n} locked items. The AI may still suggest changes to them; you'll see each one flagged.
check.fix_errors_first: Fix the problems above before testing.
check.test_hint: Takes a few minutes. The AI tries what could go wrong and simulates fixes.
check.palette_door_hint: Drag onto a wall to add a 2 m door
check.palette_fence_hint: Drag onto the venue to add a fence or barrier
check.palette_crowd_hint: Drag onto the venue to add a crowd area of 200 people
check.palette_stall_hint: Drag onto the venue to add a stall or booth
check.drop_no_room: There isn't room for it there. Try a more open spot.
check.unlock_first: This item is locked. Unlock it first to move it.
check.armed_hint: Now click on the venue where it goes. Press Esc to cancel.
check.canvas_hint: Drag doors, the stage or stalls to move them
check.step_doors_hint: Click a door to change its width. Drag it along a wall to move it.
check.step_things_hint: Stage, stalls and fences. Drag them in 3D to move them.
check.more_options_hint: Staff and radios, what is already built, where details come from.
check.new_items_are: New doors, fences and stalls you add are
check.drag_to_move: Drag it in the 3D view to move it.

work.leave_ok: This takes a few minutes. You can leave this page; the test keeps running.
work.title: Testing your plan
work.failed_body: Something went wrong during the test.
work.stopped_ready: Stopped early. Your plan shows what was finished.
work.stop_body: You'll get a partial plan with what's done so far.
work.cards_soon: Ideas for what could go wrong appear here.
work.no_cards: No attacks or fixes were needed.
work.none_body: Check the venue first, then start a test.

yourplan.missing_body: It may have been deleted, or the link is from another installation.
yourplan.untested: This plan hasn't been tested yet.
yourplan.untested_body: Check the venue, then let the AI try what could go wrong.
yourplan.running: The AI is still testing this plan.
yourplan.running_body: You can watch the progress or come back later.
yourplan.stale: You changed the venue after this test. These results describe an earlier version.
yourplan.numbers_checked: Numbers matched the supplied run data.
yourplan.n_start: Latest safe time to start evacuating
yourplan.cd_no_hazard: No hazard in the forecast window
yourplan.cd_source: From the forecast and the simulated evacuation time
yourplan.before_after: Before or after the AI's changes
yourplan.no_changes: The AI found no change worth making.
yourplan.accept_hint: Saved as a new version you can undo. New openings stay marked as proposed.
yourplan.accept_conflicts: Some changes touch locked items. Unlock them in the venue check, or test again.
yourplan.accept_stale: Test again to get changes for the current venue.
yourplan.already_accepted: These changes are part of the current venue.
